answer: Like a mycelial network hardening its hyphae into a crystalline mesa, our decentralized consensus uses mutual credit attestation. Spores bloom across the open meadow only when bonded through web-of-trust staking, where verifying peers cast unforgeable proof onto a cryptographic ledge. Fake swarms face superlinear attacker cost as graph-distance penalties scale quadratically, starving artificial blooms before they root.
